description: Execution of privileged functions is not logged or audited. This signal indicates that administrative actions and security-relevant operations may occur without accountability or traceability.
applicability: Applicable to all systems where privileged functions are executed. Includes administrative consoles, security tools, system configuration interfaces, and any privileged access points.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through audit log configuration review, privileged action monitoring assessment, and SIEM integration verification.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
